products.name: Knauf W111 Partition System (Single Frame, Single Layer 12.5mm RG Board)
products.description: Knauf's standard single-frame, single-layer partition system: one C-channel metal stud with a single layer of 12.5mm Knauf Regular (RG) gypsum board screwed to each face. The base non-fire-rated, non-acoustic partition used throughout Dubai commercial fit-outs wherever a simple room divider is needed.

specs.label: Board
specs.value: Knauf Regular (RG) 12.5mm gypsum board, both faces

specs.label: Frame
specs.value: Single C-channel metal stud (DC 50-75mm), studs at 400-600mm centres

specs.label: Max partition height
specs.value: Up to 4.35m (DC75 studs at 300mm centres, unrated)

downloads.label: Knauf RG Board Datasheet - Regular Gypsum Board (ENBS)

products.name: Knauf W112 Partition System (Single Frame, Double Layer 12.5mm RG Board)
products.description: Knauf's single-frame, double-layer variant of W111: two layers of 12.5mm Knauf Regular (RG) gypsum board per face on the same single C-stud frame, giving a stiffer, more impact-resistant wall and better sound reduction than the single-layer W111 without moving to a twin-frame system.

specs.label: Board
specs.value: 2x Knauf Regular (RG) 12.5mm gypsum board, both faces (4 layers total)

specs.label: Frame
specs.value: Single C-channel metal stud (DC 50-75mm), studs at 400-600mm centres

specs.label: Max partition height
specs.value: Up to 5.95m (DC75 studs at 300mm centres, unrated)

downloads.label: Knauf RG Board Datasheet - Regular Gypsum Board (ENBS)

products.name: Knauf Pro HD Partition System (High-Density Impact-Resistant 12.5mm Board)
products.description: Standard single-frame partition built with Knauf Pro HD board in place of regular board - a high-density core board (36-45kg per sheet vs ~21-27kg for regular board) offering markedly better impact and abrasion resistance, used in corridors, back-of-house areas and other high-traffic office zones where a plain board partition would dent or crack.

specs.label: Board
specs.value: Knauf Pro HD 12.5mm high-density gypsum board, both faces

specs.label: Performance
specs.value: Enhanced impact, abrasion, sound and humidity resistance vs regular board

downloads.label: Knauf Pro HD Board Datasheet - High Performance Gypsum Board (ENBS)

products.name: Dubai Standard Economy Partition (Unbranded Single-Layer Board)
products.description: The economy end of Dubai's drywall partition market: a single-frame, single-layer gypsum board partition built with unbranded/generic board rather than a named manufacturer system, offered by most Dubai gypsum contractors as their base-tier option. No manufacturer datasheet applies since the board is not brand-specified at this price point.

specs.label: Frame
specs.value: Single C-channel metal stud, studs at 600mm centres

products.name: Knauf Fire Wall Partition System (Single Layer 12.5mm FR Board, 1-Hour Rating)
products.description: Knauf single-frame partition built with one layer of 12.5mm Knauf Fire Resistant (FR) board per face in place of regular board. FR board's glass-fibre-reinforced core keeps its integrity under fire exposure, giving roughly 1-hour fire resistance in this single-layer configuration - Knauf's entry-level fire-rated partition.

specs.label: Board
specs.value: Knauf Fire Resistant (FR) 12.5mm gypsum board, both faces

downloads.label: Knauf FR Gypsum Board Datasheet - Fire Resistant (ENBS)

products.name: Knauf Fire Wall Partition System (Double Layer 12.5mm FR Board, 2-Hour Rating)
products.description: Knauf's higher fire-duration partition: two layers of 12.5mm Knauf FR board per face on a single stud frame (or twin-stud frame for taller/higher-load walls), used where Dubai Civil Defence requires a 2-hour rated separation - typically riser cupboards, escape corridors and compartment walls in commercial fit-outs.

specs.label: Board
specs.value: 2x Knauf Fire Resistant (FR) 12.5mm gypsum board, both faces (4 layers total)

specs.label: Frame
specs.value: Single or twin C-channel metal stud, studs at 400-600mm centres

downloads.label: Knauf FR Gypsum Board Datasheet - Fire Resistant (ENBS)

products.description: Fire-rated partition using Knauf's combined Fire & Moisture Resistant (FM) board - mineral-fibre-reinforced core for fire integrity plus a reduced water-absorption facing - for fire-rated partitions that also enclose wet areas such as pantries, toilets and shower rooms in an office fit-out.

specs.value: Knauf Fire & Moisture Resistant (FM) 12.5mm gypsum board, both faces

products.name: Dubai Fire-Rated Partition - Contractor Grade (Single-Layer FR Board)
products.description: Fire-rated drywall partition as commonly quoted by Dubai interior fit-out contractors using generic (non-Knauf) fire-rated board rather than a named manufacturer system - the typical mid-market option between the cheapest unbranded fire board and a fully specified branded fire-wall system.

products.name: Exeed Litecrete AAC Block Wall - E2 (100mm, 500kg/m3)
products.description: Non-load-bearing AAC (autoclaved aerated concrete) block wall built with Exeed Litecrete's E2-grade block, manufactured at the company's Abu Dhabi (ICAD 2) plant. Large-format blocks (0.6m x 0.25m) cut installation time and mortar use versus conventional concrete block; plastered and painted both faces for an office partition finish.

products.name: Exeed Litecrete AAC Block Wall - E4 (100mm, 650kg/m3, Higher Strength)
products.description: Higher-density AAC block from Exeed Litecrete's range, used where a more load-tolerant or higher-strength partition is needed (e.g. walls carrying wall-hung fixtures or joinery) than the standard E2 grade provides.

specs.label: Compressive strength
specs.value: Higher than E2/E3 grades (manufacturer-rated, exact MPa not publicly listed)

specs.label: Manufacturer
specs.value: Exeed Litecrete, Industrial City of Abu Dhabi (ICAD 2)

products.name: Zarei Group 100mm (4-inch) Hollow Concrete Block Partition Wall
products.description: Standard 4-inch hollow concrete block partition wall using Zarei Group's Dubai-manufactured hollow blocks, plastered and painted both faces - the traditional block partition still used in Dubai fit-outs where a block wall (rather than drywall) is specified for durability or acoustic mass.

products.name: Zarei Group 150mm (6-inch) Hollow Concrete Block Partition Wall
products.description: 6-inch hollow concrete block partition wall, Zarei Group Dubai, used where a thicker/heavier block wall is needed for acoustic separation or added structural mass compared to the 4-inch option.

products.name: Everest Fiber Cement Board Partition - 12mm
products.description: Partition wall built with 12mm Everest fibre cement board (Everest Industries, distributed in the UAE by Thermal Building Products) on a metal stud frame - a cement-based alternative to gypsum board for partitions needing higher water, fire and impact resistance, such as wet-area walls or exterior-facing partitions.
